description: TI PONTE DE PEDRA - MATO GROSSO 2013 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Carta Imagem da Terra Indígena Ponte de Pedra, localizada no estado do Mato Grosso, elaborada a partir do desmatamento ocorrido dentro da unidade até o ano de 2013, analise feita por técnicos do Sipam, com base nas Imagens do Satélite Landsat, Sensor OLI. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Terras Indígenas, Mato Grosso, environment, imageryBaseMapsEarthCover, location. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
